### add the diagnosis 

```{r}
tbl_demographics <- tbl(con,"visits_core") %>% 
  select( visit_id, race, eth, age, gender, medicaid, diagnosis) %>%
  collect 
```
###n clean up diag 
```{r}
demographics <- tbl_demographics %>% 
  replace_gender(gender)%>%
  replace_race(race) %>%
  replace_eth(eth) %>% 
  extract_unique_id(visit_id) %>%
  replace_medicaid(medicaid) %>%
  further_diagnosis(diagnosis) %>%
  enumerate_diagnosis(further_diag) %>% 
  fill_in(gender, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(eth, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(race, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(medicaid, new_id) %>% 
  mutate(age  = as.integer(age))%>% 
  select(-c(shape, num_diagnosis, new_id))
```

## set up for clustering by the syntactic and semantic
### normalize
```{r}
nlp_new_rows <- nlp_tab %>% 
  mutate(feature_type:= factor( case_when(
    str_detect( raw.colname, "freq") ~ "syntactic",
    str_detect( raw.colname, "count") ~ "syntactic",
    str_detect(raw.colname, "tangentiality") ~ "semantic",
    str_detect( raw.colname, "coherence") ~ "semantic",
    .default = "other"),
    levels = c("syntactic", "semantic", "other" ))) %>% 
  filter(feature_type !=  "other") %>% 
  group_by(raw.colname) %>%
  mutate(
    norm_val = case_when(length(unique(value)) ==1 ~ value, .default= as.vector(scale(value))))


```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(nlp_tab))

unique(nlp_tab$raw.colname)
```


### innerjoin from here 
```{r}
nlp_demo <- nlp_new_rows %>% 
  inner_join(demographics, by = "visit_id") 
```
## feature editting 
###pivot wider the features 
```{r}
 nlp_new_rows <-  nlp_new_rows %>% 
  select(norm_val, raw.colname, visit_id)
```

```{r}
nlp_new_rows%>% ungroup %>% 
  mutate(has_data=case_when(is.na(norm_val) ~ "missing", TRUE ~ "present")) %>% 
  group_by(raw.colname, has_data) %>% filter(has_data=="missing") %>% 
  summarise(n=n()) %>% arrange(-n)

nlp_new_rows %>% ungroup %>% group_by(visit_id) %>% summarise(n=n())



# %>% filter(grepl())# forgot what i was doing here 

nlp_new_rows %>% pivot_wider(names_from=raw.colname, values_from=norm_val)
```


### remove columns based on variance 
```{r}

pca_nlp <-  nlp_new_rows %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from=raw.colname, values_from=norm_val) %>% 
  select(-c(visit_id)) %>% 
  select(where(~n_distinct(.) > 1))


pca_nlp <- pca_nlp[, names(pca_nlp) != "NA"]
#names(pca_nlp)
```



### check again 

```{r}
zero_var_col <- apply(pca_nlp, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) == 0
names(pca_nlp)[zero_var_col]

```


### PCA
```{r}
my_pca <- prcomp(pca_nlp, scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE, retx = TRUE)
```
